svg.aria-label: A context switch: thread A is running when a timer interrupt or blocking system call enters the kernel; the kernel saves A's registers, the scheduler picks thread B, restores B's registers and resumes it. The direct cost is microseconds, and B then runs with cold CPU caches.
svg.title: A context switch: thread A is running when a timer interrupt or blocking system call enters the kernel; the kernel saves A's registers, the scheduler picks thread B, restores B's registers and resumes it. The direct cost is microseconds, and B then runs with cold CPU caches.
svg.text: Direct cost ~1–5 µs; the hidden cost is refilling CPU caches and TLB. Thousands per second are fine; millions are not.
